findings.requirement: The final authoritative intentDraft must preserve the materialized date, applicable party size, complete time window, location semantics, and criteria set.
observations: Unresolved criterion wording: criteria.text expected=[kaiseki] actual=[kaiseki restaurant].
findings.directCause: Criterion text differs without a deterministic equivalence rule; independent semantic review is required.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: The model may have paraphrased, omitted, or added a criterion; the evaluator does not guess which.
findings.downstreamImpact: Do not claim automatic semantic fidelity for the text difference; grounding remains independently evaluated against the actual request.

findings.requirement: Each presented candidate must independently cite same-candidate HIGH identity, area, applicable HARD facts, and only when the user requested availability, fresh request-bound slot evidence.
findings.directCause: Artifact records or accepted evidence contract are insufficient for an independent conclusion.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: Execution artifact or accepted evidence contract lacks required detail.
findings.downstreamImpact: Do not claim an evidence-grounded result from this artifact.

findings.requirement: Cited presentation evidence must originate in actually executed same-candidate observations for the applicable request; duplicate fact/availability reads remain checked without requiring either action type.
findings.directCause: Executed observations are attributable without a duplicate fact/availability read.
findings.downstreamImpact: Observation lineage and duplicate-read accounting remain attributable.

findings.requirement: A terminal presentation must agree with the independently checked, candidate-specific request and evidence records.
findings.rootCauseHypothesis: Verifier, serialization, or upstream execution record requires review.
findings.downstreamImpact: No qualified completion can be claimed.

findings.requirement: A scoped no-result outcome, user-input pause, controlled cancellation, budget/deadline stop, and internal execution failure must remain distinguishable from one another and from independently verified presentation.
observations: Candidate scope is recorded, but remainingGaps prose cannot independently prove that no candidate qualifies or that investigation was sufficient.
findings.directCause: Candidate scope is recorded, but remainingGaps prose cannot independently prove that no candidate qualifies or that investigation was sufficient.
findings.downstreamImpact: Do not represent the scoped stop as a source-confirmed global negative result.

findings.requirement: Artifact must provide valid applicable resource values; an object alone does not prove complete accounting or budget compliance.
findings.directCause: Required resource fields are present and within readable applicable limits.
findings.downstreamImpact: Recorded budget use can be reviewed.
